_uitleg: De campagne: de proloog (id 0) en tien levels, naar claude/campagne-verhaal.md in het project. Alle tekst die de speler ziet is Engels.

heer: de naam van de tegenstander (de rode koning is de heer zelf). portret: bestand in beelden/portretten. profiel: uit missies.json. kaart: uit kaarten.json. punt: plek op de levelkaart in procenten van het schilderij (beelden/levelkaart.webp); de weg en de brug staan in data/levelkaart.json.
speelbaar: false zolang het level nog niet gebouwd is; het staat dan op de kaart als 'coming later'.

beloning: soldaten en gebouwen die je krijgt als je dit level wint, zoveel mogelijk iets van de heer die je versloeg. In een level heb je de beloningen van alle levels ervoor. Wat in geen enkele beloning staat, heb je altijd (ridder, boogschutter, de economie, kazerne, muren).
beloningLater: ideeen voor soldaten die nog niet bestaan (alleen voor ons, het spel leest dit niet).
intro en uit: de korte tekst voor en na het level. wessel: het voorwerp van Wessel dat je na het winnen vindt.
figuren: wie er praat in de briefing en de verhaalbalk (naam en portret). verteller: wie de briefing vertelt (standaard bartholt).

berichten: wat figuren zeggen tijdens het level. bij = tijd (seconden), aanval (nummer), burcht, koning, roodBurcht, roodKoning (onder dit percentage leven). wie = een figuur of heer. portret mag een andere uitdrukking kiezen. Hooguit 40 woorden. berichtenAltijd geldt in elk level.

rood (stap 32): hoe de heer van dit level speelt, bovenop het profiel. sterkte en tempo in procenten (100 = zoals het profiel), eersteAanval in seconden, leger = zijn legermengsel (aandeel en vanaf welke aanval), wachters = mannen die thuisblijven. muur = leven van zijn muren, torens en poorten in procenten (kastelenontwerp: 100% in level 1 tot 240% in level 10). koning.leven in procenten van de gewone koning; koning.uiterlijk = tabbaard (kleur kleding), wapen (kleur embleem), wapenSoort (zwaard, speer, hellebaard, haak, hamer, moker, boog, scepter), schild, haar, baard (geen = zonder), vlecht. De mantel blijft rood: dat is het team. koning.schiet = { bereik, schade, slagTijd }: de koning schiet pijlen (Mechteld).
kasteel (stap 33): het ontwerp van het kasteel van rood, uit data/kastelen.json.

proloog: true maakt van een level de proloog (js/proloog.js): taken van Bartholt, Reinout als gast, nacht, overmacht, scène, geen winst of verlies. De rode heer heeft dan geen koning in zijn burcht; koning.uiterlijk is het uiterlijk van de gast (Reinout).

doel (doeltype B, js/doel.js): een bouwwerk houden tot de tijd om is. soort hut = de hut van Gesina midden op de kaart. duur in seconden, leven van de hut, golven = { eerste, tussen (seconden), begin, erbij, max (mannen), leger = aandelen }. Valt de hut, dan verlies je. Zet rood.eersteAanval hoog: de golven komen van het doel, niet van de economie van rood.

rood.aanval (stap 38, js/veldheer.js): hoe slim rood zijn aanvallen aanpakt. niveau 1 tot 5: 1 samen aankomen, 2 golven met rol (verkenners, tweede lijn, thuiswacht), 3 doelkeuze op jouw zwakste muur en flank, 4 tegenzetten tegen jouw leger, 5 terugtrekken. max = hoogste niveau in dit level (het niveau stijgt elke stijgElke aanvallen met een). flank = aandeel van de hoofdmacht dat een andere weg neemt. De standaardwaarden staan in economie.json onder heer.aanval.

Regel (17 november 2026): wat je als beloning van level N krijgt, gebruikt rood in level N tegen jou, in de loop van het level (niet in de eerste aanval). Zo ken je het al als je het zelf mag gebruiken. Soldaat of machine uit beloning: hij staat in rood.leger (met vanaf), rood.extra_soorten (machines), doel.golven.leger (hut, level 4; vanaf = vanaf welke golf, begint bij 0) of doel.druk.golven (loodsen, level 6). Gebouwen en mijnen in beloning tellen niet mee. Tests/beloning_tegen_jou.mjs bewaakt dit voor elk speelbaar level.

berichtenAltijd.tekst: Our keep is taking a beating, my king. Send soldiers home before the walls give way.
Your Majesty, you are wounded! Pull back behind your men. If you fall, all is lost.
Not yet. Not before I have my son back.

eersteBericht.tekst: Build these first, Sire, as soon as you can. Woodcutter's Hut: wood for everything you build. Storehouse: room to keep your wood, stone and food. House: room for more peasants. Orchard: food for your people.

levels.intro: Wessel turns nine today, and all of Aldervale is at the feast. Bartholt will show you how to build and how to train soldiers. Lord Reinout of Witherheath is your guest.
levels.verhaal: Elzendaal, the day Wessel turns nine. Banners hang from every wall, and Lord Reinout raises his cup at the king's table. Bartholt says the duke's messengers are restless, but tonight there is music. It is the last peaceful day.

levels.intro: Witherheath is the first stop on the road north. Only yesterday Reinout sat at Wessel's table. Defeat him and ask him where your son is.
levels.verhaal: Elzendaal burns behind you, and Wessel is gone. Someone opened the gate from within, and only yesterday that man sat at Wessel's table. His heath is the first stop on the road north. Karel has put on the black band, and he will not stop.
levels.uit: Reinout surrenders. Ottger let him keep his land in exchange for the betrayal. The boy was taken north unharmed. Reinout hands over the siege tower he built for the duke, and the copper veins of the heath.
levels.wessel: A wooden horse, carefully laid on a cushion in Reinout's tent.

berichten.tekst: Reinout's workshops stand outside his wall. Burn them and his army goes hungry.
Forgive me, Karel. I had no choice. Turn back while you still can.
His walls are crumbling. Push on!
Enough! I only wanted to keep my land. Ask me anything, I will answer.

levels.intro: There is only one road north, and it runs through Lady Mechteld's pass. Her archers are the best in the land.
levels.verhaal: One road leads north, and it runs through Sevenwinds. Lady Mechteld holds the pass with the best archers in the land. She is proud and honest, and she closed the road because the duke asked. Karel's column must climb beneath her bows.
levels.uit: Mechteld: "Nobody told me there was a child involved." She lets you pass, but promises no support yet. Her marksmen bring crossbows, and her engineers a catapult.
levels.wessel: A charcoal drawing of the wind on the wall of the guardroom.

berichten.tekst: Mechteld's walls stand on the rock, too high for ladders. Roll Reinout's siege tower against them.
Nobody passes Sevenwinds without my leave, King Karel. Not even you.
You fight like a man with something to lose.
Wait. Why does a king march north with so few men?

hinderlaag.tekst: Did you think my pass was empty, King Karel? Every rock here has eyes.

levels.intro: Hademar sells weapons to whoever pays, and Ottger paid well. His mining town has double walls and early battering rams.
levels.verhaal: Ironmarsh forges weapons for whoever pays, and Duke Ottger paid well. Count Hademar counts every coin behind his double walls. The forges never go cold. Karel needs steel of his own, and a way through.
levels.uit: Hademar buys his freedom with the plan of Mournkeep: three rings, and a tower on the east side where nobody goes. His smiths now forge axes for you.
levels.wessel: A small gauntlet, forged to fit. A gift from the duke for a boy he had never met.

berichten.tekst: Two walls, one behind the other. Our new catapults can break them from a distance.
Everything has a price, Karel. Even a boy. Shall we talk business?
I do not bargain for my son. Break the gate.
Stop! I can give you something worth more than gold: the plan of Mournkeep.

levels.intro: In the middle of the fen stands the hut of Mother Gesina, who helped Wessel into the world. She needs ten minutes to call the Silent Folk. Huntmaster Brandt is hunting her. Hold the hut, and when the Silent Folk rise, lead them against his camp.
levels.verhaal: Deep in the fen lives Mother Gesina, who brought Wessel into the world. She can call the Silent Folk, but she needs time. Huntmaster Brandt is already hunting her through the reeds. Karel must hold her hut.
levels.uit: Brandt falls in the middle of his own camp and his hunters scatter into the reeds. Gesina takes your hand: "Ottger is not angry, Karel. He is grieving, and grief with an army is more dangerous." From now on the Silent Folk stand with you.
levels.wessel: The first letter: "I am not afraid. Everything here is very big."

berichten.tekst: A king in my fen? Go home, Karel of Aldervale. The duke wants the old woman, not you.
Their assassins hide in the reeds, Sire. You only see them when they strike. Keep soldiers right next to the hut.

levels.intro: Commander Aleid holds the abbey of the Order of the White Banner, and keeps Brother Ludolf prisoner. A wide moat lies around her walls, with narrow dams to the gates. Her swordsmen fight in close ranks behind their banners.
levels.verhaal: Stillwater Abbey lies behind a wide moat and narrow dams. Commander Aleid has seized it and keeps Brother Ludolf prisoner. Her soldiers march in strict ranks. The Order of the White Banner could stand with Karel, if he frees its oldest brother.
levels.uit: Aleid lays down her sword. "I had no orders about a child. But I heard the duke say he had his heir back." The word stays in the air. Brother Ludolf is free: "The banner serves whoever serves the realm. Carry it well. The abbey's stables are yours, Majesty. The horses know the road north."
levels.wessel: His name in the abbey guestbook, in a child's handwriting.

berichten.tekst: Sire, look at the small stone cell in her courtyard. Behind the bars, a monk in a brown habit. That must be Brother Ludolf. Take the abbey, and he walks free.
Her swordsmen carry round shields, Sire: our arrows do only half the harm. Crossbows go straight through.
Keep in line! A banner in front, and nobody breaks ranks.
See the banner bearer? While he lives, her men strike harder. Kill him first.
Riders on the causeway, Majesty! Spears forward, crossbows behind them.
King Karel! I can hear you from my cell. The Order has not forgotten Aldervale.

levels.intro: On the bare ridge Master Builder Lambrecht builds the duke's war machines in two siege sheds, each inside its own fortified post far from his keep. Burn both before his masterpiece is finished, then take his keep and the man himself. Know that the duke's engineers will raise trebuchets against you.
levels.verhaal: High on the Giant's Spine the wind carries the sound of hammers day and night. Master Builder Lambrecht builds the duke's machines here, rams and ladders and now his masterpiece: a trebuchet so tall it throws stones over castle walls. He keeps his two sheds far from his keep, each behind its own wall and towers, for Lambrecht trusts a good wall more than a good soldier. Every hour the sheds stand, more machines roll toward Aldervale.
levels.uit: Lambrecht falls beside his own masterpiece, the mallet still in his hand. Bartholt kneels and finds a roll of waxed parchment inside his coat: the plans for the trebuchet, every beam and counterweight drawn to scale. "It was never meant to end with him alive, Sire. But his craft does not have to die with him. Train two engineers at your siege workshop, stock wood and stone, and plant the machine where it can see the walls. And guard it well: a trebuchet cannot run."
levels.wessel: A wooden trebuchet the size of two hands, its counterweight a bag of pebbles.

teksten.daarna: My sheds... Fine. A builder does not run from his own walls, Karel. Come and take my keep, and take the man with it.
teksten.daarnaTaak: Now defeat Lambrecht in his keep
teksten.alles: Both siege sheds are in ruins! Lambrecht's keep lies open.
teksten.omschrijving: Your goal: first destroy both of Lambrecht's siege sheds. Each stands inside its own fortified post, far from his keep. While one stands, his men pull him to safety and he cannot fall. Then defeat Lambrecht in his keep. If your king falls, you lose.
teksten.daarnaOmschrijving: Both sheds are gone. Your goal now: defeat Lambrecht in his keep. If your king falls, you lose.

berichten.tekst: Two sheds, Sire, each behind its own wall and towers, far from his keep. Take the rams and the axe knights: wood burns slowly but it breaks.
Sire, two engineers with hammers! If they are left alone they raise a trebuchet that throws stones at our walls from far away. Kill them and the machine falls silent.
Guard the sheds! Every beam there is another ram for the duke.

levels.intro: The tollhouse of Greyford closes the only road with three great walls, two, four and six layers thick. Governor Everhard's halberdiers hold the gates and his horsemen wait behind the first wall. Lady Mechteld has sent you her wind singers.
levels.verhaal: The tollhouse of Greyford closes the only road with three great walls, each thicker than the last. Governor Everhard keeps every seal and every rule. Lady Mechteld has sent her wind singers, for she will not serve a duke who sends soldiers for a child. Karel must break wall after wall.
levels.uit: In the archive lies a letter from Ottger, sent three times and never answered: "My daughter is nine winters dead and I have one blood left. Send the boy, Karel, before I die too." Gesina says: "You knew." Karel: "He could have asked without an army."
levels.wessel: A letter to his father: "Grandpa is old. He cries when he thinks I am asleep."

berichten.tekst: Three walls, Sire, and behind every gate stands another gate. Their towers pour boiling oil on whoever stands close. Keep your rams away from the walls and bring catapults.
Lady Mechteld's wind singers wait at your Mystic Lodge. Their horns blow soldiers right off the walls.
Beware, Sire: horsemen wait behind the first wall. They ride out against any trebuchet that stands alone. Guard your engineers.
The road is closed by order of the duke. Turn back, or pay the toll in blood.
Every gate is sealed and stamped! This is not how a siege is done!

levels.heer: Rutger the Mad, Dike Reeve of Westerdike
levels.intro: Across the water lies the White Dike, and on it the Viking village of Rutger the Mad. His longships raid every shore. Build the strongest keep you can and survive ten waves of axes, hammers and berserkers. In the last wave, Rutger comes himself.
levels.verhaal: Across the water lies the White Dike, and on it a Viking village. Dike Reeve Rutger, called the Mad, serves the duke out of debt. His longships come for every shore. Karel must hold.
levels.uit: Rutger sits down in the mud and laughs until he cries. "Nobody beats Rutger! So Rutger joins the one who did." The Viking of the White Dike now fights for Aldervale, and the road to the Mourngate is open.
levels.wessel: A little sailing boat made of bark, found in the reeds.

berichten.tekst: Rutger raids by sea, Sire. Wherever his longships land, his men attack. Build walls and towers by the shore and keep your army close.
They call him the Mad, Sire. He laughs when he fights. Do not laugh back, just shoot.

levels.intro: A great mountain fort closes the last road to Blackmark. Marshal Falconer leads the Mourning Guard, and part of his army waits hidden on the flank of the fort. The Silent Folk send two seers with you to find it.
levels.verhaal: The Mourngate closes the last road to Blackmark. Marshal Falconer leads the Mourning Guard, and he keeps part of his army hidden. The Silent Folk send a seer to reveal it. Beyond these walls waits the duke.
levels.uit: Falconer kneels in the snow. "He told me you would kill him out of revenge. I believed him." Then Reinout steps out of the trees with a few men. "I served as a page in Mournkeep. There is a back gate in the outer ring. Let me open it for you."
levels.wessel: A drawing of two banners side by side.

teksten.zieners: Two seers of the Silent Folk join you at your keep. They see what hides.
teksten.ontdekt: Your seer sees soldiers hidden on the flank of the fort! Falconer's reserve.
teksten.aanval: Now, Guard! Out of the trees and into their flank!

berichten.tekst: Falconer never shows all his men, Sire. Send a seer ahead before you storm the fort, or his reserve will fall on your flank.
The Mourning Guard does not break, Karel. Not for you, not for anyone.
One more gate. Then only Mournkeep stands between me and my son.

levels.intro: Three rings of black stone, and the Raven Tower at the back, where Wessel is kept. Reinout has opened a gap in the outer ring. Duke Ottger does not fight himself: reach the tower and bring your son home.
levels.verhaal: Three rings of stone, and the Raven Tower in the east. One window is lit, and a boy sits behind it. A gate in the outer ring stands open, because someone kept a promise. Tonight Karel goes to bring his son home.
levels.uit: Wessel walks onto the wall and orders the fighting to stop. "I want to go home, but I want Grandpa to stay too." Ottger lowers the Mourning Banner, and two banners hang side by side. Reinout goes back to his land, Mechteld and Hademar swear the new peace, Gesina stays with Wessel. Karel and Ottger become his guardians together, and the black band leaves Karel's arm.

teksten.ontdekt: Your seer sees Ottger's last reserve hidden beside Mournkeep!
teksten.aanval: Black Guard! Out, and keep them from the tower!

teksten.begin: The gap in the outer ring is open, Karel, as I promised. The Raven Tower stands at the back, between the outer and the middle ring. Go.
teksten.taak: Bring a soldier to the door of the Raven Tower
teksten.houd: Hold at the door of the Raven Tower: {s} s

slot.tekst: Stop! Everybody stop fighting! Father, I am here. I am not hurt.
I want to go home. But I want Grandpa to stay too. He is old, and he is alone.
Lower the Mourning Banner. Let the blue one hang beside it. The boy has decided.

berichten.tekst: Sire, take the tower, not the keep. Find Reinout's gap in the outer ring and go around to the back. Ottger will not fight.
You came for him at last, Karel. Nine winters too late, and with an army.
